title: Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level R\'enyi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13414v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R'enyi entropy (SRE) of the model's completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R'enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH5

translated_title: 免费午餐式的不确定性：基于粒子解码的序列级Rényi熵用于自适应LLM推理
translated_abstract: 量化LLM整个补全结果的不确定性对于选择性预测和自适应计算至关重要。零成本信号（如平均token熵和对数概率）仅局限于token级别或单个补全，而自洽性方法则需要许多额外的补全。我们证明，用于幂采样的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）解码本身已经在估计幂分布的归一化常数，这使我们能以零边际成本获得模型补全分布的序列级Rényi熵（SRE），且在每个粒子预算下都有保证。通过Rényi链式法则，我们将这种读出扩展到任意阶数的逐步熵族。我们证明高于1的阶数与每步最可能的token相关联，这解释了它们为何与对数概率保持一致，而1/2阶成员则累积每步搜索努力的对数。该成员在13个设置中的10个中是最佳的零成本选择性预测信号。在MATH5上
tldr: 该论文发现SMC幂采样解码可零边际成本获得序列级Rényi熵，其中1/2阶熵在13个设置中的10个中表现最佳，是用于LLM自适应推理的零成本选择性预测信号。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that SMC decoding for power sampling yields sequence-level Rényi entropy at zero marginal cost, with the order-1/2 entropy being the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings for adaptive LLM reasoning.
